risks: The coder-facing fields name test and vendored/build exclusions but do not define recognition rules for unconventional paths, so an agent working without detector output could misclassify such a file.

unobservable: finding requires the new bun_ts_metrics_detector observer to compute the ratio and emit REFACTOR-QUALITY-COMMENTS-TS-001; it is not an existing Datalog fact.

path_glob uses category placeholders such as !<test files> rather than executable globs, so classification of unconventional test, vendored, or build paths is not deterministic from the supplied facts alone.

review.summary: All independently checked compressed segments retain their operative knowledge, and the shared strict-disposition node is accurate; no dropped segments required review. The coder-facing repair decision is clear, although standalone activation still depends on the declared detector observer and concrete exclusion classification. These limitations do not undermine the rewrite's fidelity, so I agree with the auditor's PASS.
